title: [SV+] Harvester VM Info Detail v2
description: Single-VM view that complements the stock 'Harvester VM Info Detail': adds CPU Ready, honest guest memory (page cache not counted as used), launcher OOM risk, I/O latency and host pressure.

panels.title: State
panels.description: Phase and node of the VM.

panels.title: vCPUs
panels.description: Number of vCPUs.

targets.expr: count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory allocated to the domain.

panels.title: CPU Ready
panels.description: See the CPU Ready panel below.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}))

panels.title: Guest memory in use
panels.description: 100 * (1 - MemAvailable / total). Needs qemu-guest-agent.

targets.expr: 100 * (1 - max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_usable_bytes{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}) / max by (namespace, name) (kubevirt_vmi_memory_available_bytes{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}))

panels.title: Launcher mem vs limit
panels.description: virt-launcher working set / memory limit.

panels.title: CPU usage % of vCPUs
panels.description: kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total (guest + hypervisor) / vCPUs.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}))

panels.title: CPU Ready %
panels.description: Run-queue delay per vCPU (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_delay_seconds_total). vSphere CPU Ready analogue.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_delay_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}))

panels.title: vCPU I/O wait %
panels.description: Time vCPUs were blocked on I/O.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, name) (rate(kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_wait_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}[5m])) / count by (namespace, name) (group by (namespace, name, id) (kubevirt_vmi_vcpu_seconds_total{namespace="$namespace",name="$vm"}))

panels.title: Launcher CFS throttling %
panels.description: Share of periods the launcher hit its CPU limit.

panels.title: Guest memory breakdown
panels.description: available = total seen by guest; usable = MemAvailable (free + reclaimable); unused = completely free; cached = page cache. In use = available - usable.

panels.title: Guest swap and major faults
panels.description: Swap traffic delta (gauge counters) and major page faults/s.

panels.title: Launcher working set vs request/limit
panels.description: Host-side memory of the launcher pod against what it is allowed. Working set approaching the limit = OOM risk.

panels.title: IOPS
panels.description: Read/write operations per second.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Read/write bytes per second.

panels.title: Latency per I/O
panels.description: rate(times) / rate(ops). The stock dashboard's 'IO Time' shows the raw rate of the time counter, which is not a latency.

panels.title: Guest filesystem used %
panels.description: From the guest agent (kubevirt_vmi_filesystem_*).

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Bits per second per interface.

panels.title: Dropped packets/s
panels.description: rx + tx drops.

panels.title: Errors/s
panels.description: rx + tx errors.

panels.title: VM cgroup pressure (PSI)
panels.description: % of time this VM's launcher cgroup stalled waiting for CPU, memory or I/O ('some'), from cAdvisor.

panels.title: Node pressure (PSI) [needs kernel PSI]
panels.description: CPU, memory and I/O pressure of the hosting node ('some'). Empty if that node's kernel boots without PSI (psi=1).

panels.title: Node memory available %
panels.description: MemAvailable / MemTotal of the hosting node.

targets.expr: (100 * node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes) * on (instance) group_left (nodename) max by (instance, nodename) (node_uname_info{nodename="$node"})

panels.title: Node major faults/s and OOM kills
panels.description: node_vmstat_pgmajfault rate and OOM kills of the hosting node.
